summary: Describes how X.509 keys and signatures are identified and encoded for use in version 2 of the KeyNote trust-management system. X.509 certificates can then appear directly in KeyNote assertions, making it easier to combine the two systems. It is informational.

eli5.summary: KeyNote is a system for deciding who is allowed to do what, and X.509 is a common form of digital ID card. This document explains how to put those ID cards into KeyNote's rules.

questions: how to use x.509 with keynote
